name: bread-trail
description: Navigate and edit your Breadcrumbs graph — view hierarchies, tile explorer, quick-switch between related notes, and more.

scripts.reload: node esbuild.config.mjs production && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dev-config.json','utf8'));const dirs=[c.vaultPluginDir,...(c.extraCopyDirs||[])];const files=['main.js','manifest.json','styles.css'];for(const d of dirs){for(const f of files){if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,d+'/'+f);}}" && /Applications/Obsidian.app/Contents/MacOS/obsidian-cli plugin:reload id=bread-trail
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json CHANGELOG.md changelog.d
